<noinclude><pagequality level="4" user="Yann" />{{rh||I ÂRA''N''YAKA, 3 ADHYÂYA, 2 KHA''ND''A, 9.|181}}{{rule}}</noinclude><section begin="aranyaka1 adhyaya3" />18. Verily, these are all metres, these (Gâyatrî, Trish''t''ubh, ''G''agatî) having the Virâ''g'' as the fourth. In this manner this day is complete in all metres to him who knows this.


{{sh|{{sc|{{Anchor+|Khanda5|Fifth Kha''nd''a}}.}}}}

1. He extends these (verses) by (interpolating) the sound<ref>The sound, nada, is really a verse beginning with nadam, and which is interpolated after the syllables pu ru sha''h''.</ref> Verily, the sound is purusha, man. Therefore every man when he speaks, sounds loud, as it were.

2. At the end of each foot of the first verse of the hymn tad id âsa, he inserts one foot of the second verse of hymn Rv. VIII, 69, nada''m'' va odatînâm &c. Thus the verse is to be recited as follows:

{| style="text-align: left; align: center; margin: 0 auto 0 auto;" |
| style="padding-left: 3em; text-indent: -3em; padding-right: 6px;" | {{lang|sa-Latl|Tad id âsa bhuvaneshu ''g''yesh''th''am nada''m'' va odatînâm,}}
| valign="top" | pu
|-
| style="padding-left: 3em; text-indent: -3em;" | {{lang|sa-Latl|Yato ''g''a''g''ña ugras tveshan''ri''m''n''o nada''m'' yoyuvatînâm,}}
| valign="top" | ru
|-
| style="padding-left: 3em; text-indent: -3em;" | {{lang|sa-Latl|Sadyo ''g''a''g''ñâno ni ri''n''âti ''s''atrûn pati''m'' vo aghnyânâm,}}
| 
|-
| style="padding-left: 3em; text-indent: -3em;" | {{lang|sa-Latl|Anu ya''m'' vi''s''ve madanti ûmâ''h'' dhenûnâm ishudhyasi.}}
| valign="top" | sho
|}
<ref follow="p180">first verse consist of ten syllables only, the fourth of nine or ten. In order to bring them to the right number, the word {{lang|sa-Latl|purusha}} is to be added to what is a Virâ''g'', i. e. to the first, the second, and fourth feet. We thus get:
{| style="text-align: left; margin: 0 auto 0 auto;" |
| {{lang|sa-Latl|tad id âsa bhuvaneshu ''g''yesh''th''am}}
| pu
|-
| {{lang|sa-Latl|yato ''g''a''g''ña ugras tveshan''ri''m''n''o}}
| ru
|-
| {{lang|sa-Latl|sadyo ''g''a''g''ñâno ni ri'''n''âti satrûn}}
|
|-
| {{lang|sa-Latl|anu ya''m'' vi''s''ve madanti ûmâ''h''}}
| sha''h''.
|}
Cf. Ait. Âr. V, 1, 6.</ref>
